# Codelist for Myocardial Infarction

The following codelist contains Read codes and SNOMED CT concept identifiers from CPRD representing a diagnosis or acute/current presentation of myocardial infarction (including ST-elevation myocardial infarction [STEMI], non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction [NSTEMI], acute transmural and subendocardial infarction, postoperative MI, subsequent MI, MINOCA, and current complications following acute MI). 

Excluded are codes indicating family history of MI, past/old/healed MI, aborted MI, ECG findings alone, and coronary thrombosis not resulting in MI.

# Codelist for Myocardial Infarction

The following codelist contains Read codes and SNOMED CT concept identifiers from CPRD representing a diagnosis or acute/current presentation of myocardial infarction (including ST-elevation myocardial infarction [STEMI], non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction [NSTEMI], acute transmural and subendocardial infarction, postoperative MI, subsequent MI, MINOCA, and current complications following acute MI). 

Excluded are codes indicating family history of MI, past/old/healed MI, aborted MI, ECG findings alone, and coronary thrombosis not resulting in MI.

| Code | Term |
| :--- | :--- |
| **G30** | Acute myocardial infarction |
| **G300** | Acute anterolateral myocardial infarction |

Here is the codelist for **Myocardial Infarction** derived from the CPRD database. 

This list includes clinical diagnosis codes, diagnostic findings, historical/past event records, complications, and subtype-specific codes (e.g., STEMI, NSTEMI, transmural, subendocardial, and postoperative MI) indicating that a patient has or has had a myocardial infarction. 

Non-cases (such as family history of MI, observation/suspected MI, aborted MI, coronary thrombosis without infarction, risk score assessments, or negative ECG results) have been excluded.
